example.name: basic-report
example.source: Example 2. The most basic report payload

example.name: report-with-text
example.source: Example 3. Report with optional reason and text

examples.example: <report xmlns="urn:xmpp:reporting:1" reason="urn:xmpp:reporting:spam"> <text xml:lang="en"> Never came trouble to my house like this. </text> </report>

example.name: report-with-opt-in
example.source: Example 4. Report with optional processing opt-in

examples.example: <report xmlns="urn:xmpp:reporting:1" reason="urn:xmpp:reporting:spam"> <text xml:lang="en"> Never came trouble to my house like this. </text> <report-origin/> <third-party/> </report>

example.name: block-and-report
example.source: Example 5. Report sent with blocking command

examples.example: <iq from='juliet@example.com/chamber' type='set' id='block1'> <block xmlns='urn:xmpp:blocking'> <item jid='romeo@example.net'> <report xmlns="urn:xmpp:reporting:1" reason="urn:xmpp:reporting:abuse"/> </item> </block> </iq>

example.name: report-with-stanza-ids
example.source: Example 6. Report sent with stanza IDs

examples.example: <iq from='juliet@example.com/chamber' type='set' id='block1'> <block xmlns='urn:xmpp:blocking'> <item jid='romeo@example.net'> <report xmlns="urn:xmpp:reporting:1" reason="urn:xmpp:reporting:spam"> <stanza-id xmlns='urn:xmpp:sid:0' by='romeo@example.net' id='28482-98726-73623'/> <stanza-id xmlns='urn:xmpp:sid:0' by='romeo@example.net' id='38383-38018-18385'/> <text xml:lang="en"> Never came trouble to my house like this. </text> </report> </item> </block> </iq>
